mechanism: Tranylcypromine is a non-selective MAOI that inhibits monoamine oxidase, while perampanel is an AMPA receptor antagonist; combined use increases risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome due to MAOI effects, plus additive CNS depression.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, ensure adequate washout of tranylcypromine (14 days) before initiating perampanel and monitor closely for hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome symptoms.
